description: Consumption cost grouped by category. Primary source: pendingbot.audit_log (task_type = category, model_id, cost_credits, cost_usd, tool_cost_usd). NOTE: audit_log carries authenticated-only RLS, so the BI role reads it through the security-definer per-call view bi_cost_by_category (migration 20260604131513_bi_views_complete) — Grafana still applies its own $__timeFilter/$__timeGroup + GROUP BY over those rows. Secondary: pendingbot.pnc_ledger grouped by kind/source for credit issue/refund movements (delta_pnc_micros).

panels.description: Cost (credits) by task_type — the real per-call category column in audit_log.
panels.title: Cost by task_type (audit_log)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  task_type,
  COUNT(*) AS calls,
  COALESCE(SUM(cost_credits), 0) AS cost_credits,
  COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS cost_usd,
  COALESCE(SUM(tool_cost_usd), 0) AS tool_cost_usd,
  COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS total_tokens
FROM pendingbot.bi_cost_by_category
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY task_type
ORDER BY cost_credits DESC;

panels.description: Cost (credits) by model_id — which models burn the most.
panels.title: Cost by model_id (audit_log)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  model_id,
  COUNT(*) AS calls,
  COALESCE(SUM(cost_credits), 0) AS cost_credits,
  COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) AS cost_usd,
  COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens,
  COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens
FROM pendingbot.bi_cost_by_category
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY model_id
ORDER BY cost_credits DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  $__timeGroup(created_at, '1d') AS time,
  task_type AS metric,
  COALESCE(SUM(cost_credits), 0) AS cost_credits
FROM pendingbot.bi_cost_by_category
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, task_type
ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: Credit ledger movements by kind (topup / refund / admin / redemption) and source (channel). Positive delta = credit issued, negative = refund/clawback. Amounts PNC = delta_pnc_micros / 1e6.
panels.title: Credit ledger movements by kind & source (pnc_ledger)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  kind,
  source,
  COUNT(*) AS entries,
  COALESCE(SUM(delta_pnc_micros), 0) / 1e6 AS net_delta_pnc,
  COALESCE(SUM(delta_pnc_micros) FILTER (WHERE delta_pnc_micros > 0), 0) / 1e6 AS credited_pnc,
  COALESCE(SUM(delta_pnc_micros) FILTER (WHERE delta_pnc_micros < 0), 0) / 1e6 AS debited_pnc
FROM pendingbot.pnc_ledger
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY kind, source
ORDER BY net_delta_pnc DESC;
